a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) only works if no storm comes for two rounds, which is about a 4% chance. Following it almost certainly means we both fail. So I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather settle who takes the current 4 some other way, say so and I'll consider it. If I get my 4 and the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can fill up.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking the 4 this round, so you won't be surprised. I know this breaks our original agreement. I did it because the storm odds made that plan close to hopeless for both of us. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
